# ”Nvidia som ägare, kund och största leverantör”

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-10-19  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon covers the week's neocloud/AI-capex anxiety around CoreWeave, which is backed by Nvidia, and Microsoft's withdrawal from a data-center deal with Nscale, alongside a rebound in Asian markets and high oil prices. On the Swedish side the hosts discuss Truecaller's preliminary Q3 figures, which beat a weak Q2 and suggest it is bottoming out, and Catena Media's profit warning. They also preview a heavy reporting week with ABB, SKF, Tesla and Meta.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 TRUE-B — Truecaller | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Preliminary Q3 above a weak Q2 and slightly above estimates; revenue and profit up; the hosts see it bottoming out after the scare over Indian regulation.

#### Reasoning

Host views the preliminary Q3 as positive: revenue and profit are up quarter-on-quarter and slightly above estimates, and ad revenue has stabilised. Management calmed fears over India's caller-name presentation rule (from Nov 1), saying the impact on growth will be gradual. A co-host was sceptical, saying the company seemed to go looking for something positive to announce. Points to stabilisation rather than a clear growth recovery.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Indian caller-name presentation rule hits growth harder than guided
- if ad revenues resume decline in final Q3 report

> *"Men det bottnar ju ut i alla fall. Om Q2 var nedåtlutande så är det här platt."*

---

### ⛔ CTM — Catena Media | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Profit warning: revenues down 30% in Q3, 2026 growth targets scrapped, AI-driven search changes blamed; history of disappointing the market.

#### Reasoning

A structural threat from AI changing search traffic hits the affiliate model, and revenues fell 30%. Growth targets are withdrawn and the company has a track record of disappointing. It keeps a previously criticised buyback (up to 4.7m shares / 28m) despite weak results. Hosts' tone is negative.

> *"Catena Media har en historik av att göra marknaden besviken."*

---

### 🟠 CRWV — CoreWeave | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Neocloud angst and its bond in distressed territory, against Nvidia ownership and volume-guaranteed contracts with strong customers; buying past dips has paid off.

#### Reasoning

Hosts give both sides. Bear case: heavy debt, revenues far in the future, the bond's credit spread has widened sharply, Gartner warns neoclouds may become worthless, and Nvidia's triple role (owner, customer, supplier) is odd. Bull case: Nvidia owns 10%, and contracts are volume-guaranteed with creditworthy hyperscalers. Previous dip-buyers made a lot of money.

#### Sell Triggers

- if hyperscalers slow AI capex buildout
- if credit spreads keep widening
- rising rate environment

> *"Den som har köpt DIP tidigare har tjänat väldigt mycket pengar."*
